description: This file stays at the repository root; Renovate ignores nested copies without error.
Match paths are repository-root-relative and move with their targets; a stale path selects nothing without failing.
Minor and patch updates automerge after quarantine; major and vulnerability updates require review unless a technical constraint below overrides the policy.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Minor and patch automerge after quarantine and a green gate
Bun packageManager version, grouped with its regex-tracked copies so the bump lands in one PR
Bun version wherever the regex manager finds it

description: HOLDBACK HB-2026-003: TypeScript is held at 6.0.3.
typescript-eslint declares `typescript: ">=4.8.4 <6.1.0"` and refuses to load on TypeScript 7.
Closes when: typescript-eslint releases with TypeScript 7 support.
HOLDBACK HB-2026-004: ESLint is held at 9.39.5.
eslint-plugin-react calls a rule-context API that ESLint 10 removed.
Closes when: eslint-plugin-react releases compatible with ESLint 10.
jdx/mise and oven-sh/bun reach Renovate through the github-actions manager as the
version INPUTS of jdx/mise-action and oven-sh/setup-bun, not as action refs.
github-actions.pinDigests above therefore applied to them too, and the digest lookup
failed: both projects tag releases with a prefix (v2026.9.15, bun-v1.4.2), so there is
no git object for the bare version. That is the 'Could not determine new digest for
update ... did you maybe mean the suggestedValue, with a v prefix?' dashboard warning.
A digest would be meaningless here anyway: the action resolves the version against the
upstream release at run time, not against a git object pinned in this repository.
One bun version lives in six places: packageManager and engines.bun in package.json,
the setup-bun bun-version input in ci.yml (twice) and canary-renewal-reminder.yml, and
both oven/bun stages in the Dockerfile. Renovate reaches them through four managers
(npm, custom.regex, github-actions, dockerfile) under three package names, and the two
rules above this one grouped only the first two. The rest opened their own branches
against the same package.json lines, which is what produced the duplicate renovate/bun
and renovate/bun-1.x pair and the 'Detected empty commit - aborting git push' warning.
Matching every name with no manager filter keeps the whole bump in one PR.
HOLDBACK HB-2026-005: eslint-plugin-unicorn is held at 65.x.
66.0.0 and later declare `eslint: ">=10.4"`, and ESLint is held at 9 by HB-2026-004,
so taking unicorn alone would leave an unsatisfied peer range rather than an upgrade.
AGENTS.md section 9 already documented this hold in prose; nothing enforced it, so
Renovate kept proposing the major. Closes when: HB-2026-004 closes.
